title: Agent chat correctness fixes: wire callbacks in PROD (critical) + abort/error precedence + orphaned tool-result + hardening
description:
DONE. Agent-chat correctness fixes (all 4 items). EVIDENCE (reproducible, run from worktree):

(1) CRITICAL prod callback wiring — Shell.tsx: the setAgentCallbacks() useEffect (~2920) was test-gated (DEV/VITE_FLASH_TEST early-return) alongside the WebSocket bridge. The in-browser Agent Chat (AgentChatPanel→tools.ts→dispatchAgentCommand→requireCallbacks) and the MCP bridge both need these callbacks, so in a prod build every tool call threw 'Editor not ready: agent callbacks not wired'. FIX: removed the isTestEnv gate from the setAgentCallbacks block so it runs in ALL environments. The WHY of the original gate: it was bundled with startAgentBridge() — the /__agent WebSocket transport used by the external flash-agent CLI / MCP server, which IS genuinely test/dev-only. That WebSocket block (~3057) plus the __flashTest automation bridge and __agentChatTestStub (imports ai/test) stay isTestEnv-gated. PROD-PATH SANITY CHECK: 'pnpm vite build' (DEV=false) succeeds; the prod main chunk contains the callback readers (getSelectedIds ×6) and the requireCallbacks error string, while ai/test/testStub is code-split into a separate lazy chunk that the still-gated DEV effect never imports in prod.

(2) MEDIUM abort/error precedence — agentLoop.ts reduceAgentEvent: 'abort' and 'error' now gate on state.status==='running' like 'finish' (first terminal wins). error-then-abort keeps error; abort-then-error keeps stopped. New tests added.

(3) MEDIUM orphaned tool-result — agentLoop.ts patchTool: a tool-result/tool-error with an unknown toolCallId is no longer silently dropped; warnOrphanedToolResult() logs console.warn naming the id. New tests for orphaned tool-result and tool-error.

(4) LOW hardening — openrouterClient.ts createDashOpenRouter trims the key (call sites needn't; fetchOpenRouterModels already trimmed). AgentChatPanel responseMessages append guarded against undefined. No API key is logged anywhere (grep clean).

VERIFY:
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build => OK (tsc clean).
- pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run => 56 files, 765 tests, 0 failures (incl 29 in agentLoop.test.ts, openrouterClient/tools/systemPrompt). No task-1207 fixture failures observed.
- pnpm --filter @flash/desktop e2e agent-chat-drives-stage => 1 passed (model tool-call → dispatchAgentCommand → live doc rect). Confirms callbacks wired path end-to-end.
- pnpm vite build (apps/desktop, prod) => built OK; prod-bundle grep confirms callbacks live + testStub code-split.
